text: Given provider 1003000555 exists in provider-service and has one earlier screening, and an ANALYST token When the ANALYST calls POST /api/v1/screenings with npi 1003000555 Then the response is 202 with a Screening of reason MANUAL and status RUNNING, and when it completes GET /api/v1/screenings/{screeningId} shows four fresh results while GET /api/v1/screenings?npi=1003000555 still returns the earlier screening unchanged

text: Given an ANALYST token When POST /api/v1/screenings is called with npi 123, and then with npi 1003000999, which provider-service does not know Then the first call returns 400 and the second returns 404, both with a problem+json body, and no screening is created

text: Given revalidation-service has published RevalidationDue for a case of NPI 1003000222 with dueDate 2026-02-28 When screening-service receives the event Then a screening with reason REVALIDATION is started for 1003000222 and, when it completes, a ScreeningCompleted with reason REVALIDATION is published for it

title: One re-screening per revalidation case

basis: QUESTION C-2, D-014, ADR-002, D-016, aws-transform/test-data/license_board.txt
text: Given provider 1003000111 passed its first screening with licence MD12345, and provider-service GET /api/v1/providers/1003000111 now returns licence PT99900 in TX (EXPIRED on the licence-board mock) When a MANUAL screening of 1003000111 runs Then the licence-board mock's request log shows a lookup for PT99900, not for MD12345, and the new screening's LICBOARD result is F with errorCode E202

text: Given tokens for ANALYST, SUPERVISOR, SYSTEM, PROVIDER and ADMIN, and a request with no token When each calls POST /api/v1/screenings with npi 1003000111 Then ANALYST, SUPERVISOR and SYSTEM are accepted with 202, PROVIDER and ADMIN receive 403 and the request with no token receives 401
title: Only analysts, supervisors and the system can start a screening

text: Given the gateway at http://localhost:8080, the nine service skeletons running, and the nine OpenAPI contracts (1.0.0) When a request with an X-Correlation-Id is sent through the gateway to every path of those contracts, including /api/v1/batch/..., /api/v1/legacy/... and /fhir/... Then each request is forwarded to the service that owns it (provider 8081, enrollment 8082, screening 8083, risk 8084, revalidation 8085, sanctions 8086, notification 8087, directory 8088, tmsis 8089), shown by its correlation id in that service's log, and no request gets the gateway's own 404 'no route' answer
title: Every contract path is routed to its owning service

text: Given a caller with no token When GET /api/v1/directory/providers, GET /fhir/Practitioner, GET /fhir/Organization and GET /fhir/PractitionerRole are called through the gateway, and then GET /api/v1/providers Then the four public calls are forwarded to directory-service without a token and are never answered 401, and GET /api/v1/providers answers 401
title: Directory and FHIR need no token, everything else does

text: Given an ANALYST token and a PROVIDER token When a protected path is called through the gateway with each Then the owning service receives exactly the Authorization header that was sent, so the role decision is made by the service itself, and the gateway adds no role, claim or identity header of its own
title: The token is relayed unchanged

text: Given the web UI origin http://localhost:5173 and another origin When a preflight OPTIONS request is sent from each Then the answer for http://localhost:5173 allows the methods and the headers Authorization, Content-Type and X-Correlation-Id, and the other origin gets no CORS allow header
title: CORS allows the web UI only

text: Given one request with an X-Correlation-Id header and one without When both are sent through the gateway Then the first keeps its id and the second gets a generated one, the service receives the id on both, and both responses return it in the X-Correlation-Id header
title: A correlation id is accepted or generated

text: Given an unknown path, and a service that is stopped When each is called through the gateway Then the unknown path answers 404 and the stopped service answers 503, both as RFC 7807 problem details that carry the correlation id and no stack trace or internal host name
title: Clear errors for unknown routes and unavailable services

basis: R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00008, R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00039, R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00041, R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00045, R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00046, D-004, 42 CFR 455.414 (five-year revalidation; summary from .claude/skills/pem-domain/SKILL.md section 5, UNVERIFIED against eCFR)

basis: R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00040, R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00042, R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00043, R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00044, D-004 (pivot at 70 gives 19xx from 2065)

basis: D-003, Q-A4 (a MANUAL result changes only the screen flag), R-PRVRSK01-ADD-01

title: Only approval and a passed revalidation move the date

text: Given the ScreeningCompleted REVALIDATION PASS event with id E4 was already processed When E4 is delivered again (on a later clock date) Then revalidationDueDate keeps its value and no second ProviderStatusChanged event is published
title: A redelivered revalidation result is applied once

text: Given any service publishing an event When the message on its Kafka topic is read Then it is JSON with id (uuid), type, source, time (ISO-8601), subject (the NPI), correlationId (uuid) and data, it is on topic pem.<service>.events with the NPI as message key, and a contract test fails when a message does not match modern/contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml
title: Every event has the agreed envelope, topic and key

text: Given a service that changes its state and publishes an event When the transaction commits, and in a second case rolls back Then after the commit the event appears once on the topic, and after the rollback no event appears
title: The event is written in the same transaction as the change

text: Given Kafka is stopped while a service commits a change When Kafka is started again Then the event is published after the restart (at least once, none lost) and the outbox row is marked published
title: No event is lost when Kafka is unavailable

basis: modern/docs/adr/ADR-003-events-and-outbox.md, .claude/skills/java-microservices/SKILL.md section 7, modern/docs/architecture/nfr.md (Availability: Kafka consumers are idempotent)
text: Given a consumer that has handled event id X When the same event id X is delivered again Then the second delivery has no effect on the consumer's data and the consumer's processed_event record holds X once
title: A repeated event is applied once

text: Given a request that carries X-Correlation-Id When it causes an event that another service consumes Then the envelope correlationId equals that id, and the consumer's log lines and any event it publishes next carry the same id
title: The correlation id travels with the event

text: Given make up When the Kafka topic list is read Then pem.enrollment.events, pem.provider.events, pem.screening.events, pem.risk.events, pem.revalidation.events, pem.sanctions.events, pem.notification.events and pem.tmsis.events exist
title: The eight topics exist before services start

text: Given a consumer that fails on one message every time When the message is delivered and later messages arrive on the same topic Then the message is retried a configured number of times, then written to the dead-letter topic <topic>.DLT with its original envelope, an error log line names its event id and correlation id, and the later messages are still processed
title: A message that cannot be processed is parked and surfaced, not dropped

text: Given the Gradle build When ./gradlew projects is run and the service build files are read Then the module libs:service-kit holds the envelope type, the outbox writer and poller, the idempotent-consumer helper and the dead-letter handler (package gov.medicaid.pem.kit.events), every service that publishes or consumes events depends on it, and ADR-012 records the module
title: One shared module for envelope, outbox and idempotency

basis: R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00053, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00054, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00055, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00056, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00057, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00058, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00059, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00060, R-PRVSCR01-ADD-02, D-005, D-004, ADR-005, QUESTION C-7, modern/docs/analysis/data-layouts.md#SCRNREC, .claude/skills/cobol-to-java/SKILL.md (padding and truncation only in legacy-format adapters)
text: Given the run of criterion 2 has completed When an ADMIN calls GET /api/v1/batch/screening-runs/{runId}/results-file Then the body has 8 records of 67 bytes, four per screened provider in ascending NPI order (1003000111 then 1003000555) and, for each provider, in the order LICBOARD, OIGLEIE, SAMGOV, SSADMF; each record holds NPI (bytes 1-10), SOURCE (11-18, left-justified, space-padded), RESULT (19, P, F or C), VERDICT-DATE (20-27, CCYYMMDD, here 20260331) and DETAIL (28-67, left-justified, cut to 40 characters)
title: The SCRNOUT file has four 67-byte rows per screened provider

text: Given provider 1003000555 (licence PT99900, EXPIRED on the licence-board mock) is screened by the run When the SCRNOUT file of the run is downloaded Then its LICBOARD row has RESULT F and its OIGLEIE, SAMGOV and SSADMF rows have RESULT P (the legacy wrote P on every row)

basis: R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00012, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00048, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00061, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00062, D-024, ADR-004 (every run records its counts and failure reason), QUESTION C-8, modern/docs/analysis/data-layouts.md#WRKSTORE (read, written, skipped, errored counters)
text: Given the run of criterion 2 (4 providers read, 2 screened, 2 skipped, 1 failed) When an ADMIN reads the run through GET /api/v1/batch/screening-runs/{runId} (run-status call proposed by question C-8; not in contract 1.0.0) Then the BatchRun has status COMPLETED, an endedAt time and counts read 4, screened 2, skipped 2 and failed 1, where failed is the number of providers whose screening result is FAIL
title: The run records how many providers it read, screened, skipped and failed

basis: R-PRVSCR01-ADD-04, R-PRVSCR01-ADD-05, R-PRVSCR01-ADD-06, D-024, ADR-004, QUESTION C-8, modern/contracts/openapi/screening-service.yaml#BatchRun (status FAILED, error)
text: Given a run during which provider-service answers 5xx, and another run whose SCRNOUT file cannot be written When each run executes and an ADMIN reads it through the run-status call of question C-8 Then each run ends with status FAILED and the reason in error, it stops reading providers instead of retrying for ever, and it is never reported as COMPLETED
title: A failure is reported, never silent

basis: modern/docs/architecture/nfr.md#Availability (batch jobs can be re-run for a business date and are idempotent), ADR-004, R-PRVSCR01-cbl-00022
text: Given the run for 2026-03-31 has completed and an INITIAL screening (RUNNING or COMPLETED) exists for 1003000111 and 1003000555, whose screen flag is still U in provider-service When another run is started for 2026-03-31 Then no further screening and no further ScreeningCompleted is created for 1003000111 or 1003000555, and the second run's SCRNOUT file has no rows for them
title: Running again does not screen anyone twice

text: Given a completed run id, an unknown run id, and tokens for ADMIN, SYSTEM, ANALYST and PROVIDER When each calls GET /api/v1/batch/screening-runs/{runId}/results-file, and ADMIN also calls it with the unknown run id Then ADMIN receives 200 with the file, SYSTEM, ANALYST and PROVIDER receive 403, and the unknown run id returns 404 with a problem+json body

text: Given provider 1003000111 is ACTIVE When a SYSTEM caller sends POST /api/v1/providers/1003000111/status-changes with action TERMINATE, reason 'LEIE exclusion' and effectiveDate 2026-03-31 Then the response is 200 with enrollStatus T, and the terminations counter on /actuator/metrics rises by 1

basis: R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00005, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00015, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00030, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00041, D-006, modern/docs/ux/journeys.md#J5

basis: R-PRVSAN01-ADD-04, D-027, Q-006 (answered: apply as written)
text: Given provider 1003000444 is in status D (denied) and provider 1003000222 is in status P (pending) When REINSTATE is sent for 1003000444 and TERMINATE for 1003000222 Then GET /api/v1/providers/1003000444 returns enrollStatus A and GET /api/v1/providers/1003000222 returns T (the legacy rule applied as written)

basis: R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00007, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00028, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00031, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00035, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00043, modern/contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml (ProviderStatusChanged), D-013
text: Given provider 1003000111 is ACTIVE When a SYSTEM caller (service-account-pem-services) applies SUSPEND with reason 'LEIE exclusion' Then a later GET /api/v1/providers/1003000111 returns enrollStatus S, and one ProviderStatusChanged event with key 1003000111 has from A, to S, reason 'LEIE exclusion' and actor service-account-pem-services

text: Given provider 1003000111 is ACTIVE When a SYSTEM caller sends action PURGE with effectiveDate 2026-03-31, and then action SUSPEND with no effectiveDate Then each response is 422 problem+json, the provider is unchanged (status A, same version) and no ProviderStatusChanged event is published (the legacy program would have rewritten the record and called the general notice)

text: Given the seeded stack and an ANALYST token When GET /api/v1/providers/{npi} is called for 1003000111, 1003000222, 1003000333, 1003000444, 1003000555, 1003000666, 1003000777, 1003000888 and 1990000111 Then each call returns 404, so applying with them is never a duplicate (E103), and no seeded NPI lies in 1003000000-1003000999 or 1990000000-1990000999
title: Journey applicants are never pre-registered

basis: QF-6 (default applied), .claude/commands/phase-8-e2e-hardening.md step 2 (journeys run 3 times in a row), .claude/agents/devops-engineer.md deliverable 5
text: Given a seeded stack in which the test set-up has added one extra provider row When make seed is run again, and then a third time Then after each run GET /api/v1/providers/{npi} returns 404 for the extra provider and the seeded providers are unchanged, so each journey can start from the same state
title: make seed restores exactly the seed state

text: Given one service's database is not reachable When make seed is run Then it stops with a non-zero exit and a message naming that service, and running make seed again once the database is back gives the full seed state
title: A seed failure is explicit

basis: .claude/skills/synthetic-data/SKILL.md section 1, MODERNIZATION.md section 6 rule 4, QF-12 (default applied)
text: Given all SQL seed files When a scan runs over them Then it finds only obviously fake names (such as TESTPROV ALPHA, SAMPLE CLINIC 01) and NPIs with a valid check digit outside the reserved ranges, and fails on anything else
title: Seed data is synthetic

text: Given the seeded stack and an ANALYST token When GET /api/v1/providers is called, after one make seed and again after a second make seed Then both times the total equals the number of records in fixed-width/provider-master-seed.dat and the listed NPIs are exactly those of the file
title: The provider list matches the seed file

basis: D-018, D-005, modern/docs/architecture/overview.md (main flow 2: four mocked sources, one result per source), modern/contracts/openapi/screening-service.yaml (SourceResult)
text: Given the seeded stack and an ANALYST token When GET /api/v1/screenings?npi=<npi> is called for every seeded provider with screen flag P or F Then each has a completed screening with one result for each of LICBOARD, OIGLEIE, SAMGOV and SSADMF; a provider with flag P has only P results and a provider with flag F has at least one F result with its error code
title: Screened providers have one result per source

text: Given the seeded stack and an ANALYST token When GET /api/v1/sanctions?npi=<npi> is called for every seeded provider with status T or S Then each has a sanction row whose action matches its status (T for TERMINATED, S for SUSPENDED) with a reason and an effective date
title: Terminated and suspended providers have a sanction history

basis: D-028, Q-008, modern/docs/architecture/overview.md (main flow 6: read model of active providers)
text: Given the seeded stack and a caller with no token When GET /api/v1/directory/providers is called page by page Then it lists exactly the seeded providers with status A, an individual's displayName is the first name then the last name (TESTPROV ALPHA) and an organisation's displayName is its legal name
title: The directory lists exactly the active providers with composed names

basis: D-029, D-020, modern/docs/architecture/overview.md (revalidation-service keeps its own read model, difference 4), modern/docs/ux/journeys.md#J6 steps 1-2
text: Given the seeded stack, no event replayed since make seed When an ADMIN runs POST /api/v1/batch/revalidation-sweeps with businessDate 2026-03-31 and GET /api/v1/revalidations?status=DUE is called with an ANALYST token Then there is exactly one DUE case for each seeded ACTIVE provider whose due date is on or before 2026-03-31 and none for any other provider
title: The revalidation read model is seeded, not replayed

basis: R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00002, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00018, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00019, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00020, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00025, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00004, D-012, D-013, D-018, modern/contracts/openapi/provider-service.yaml#changeProviderStatus, modern/contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml#SanctionApplied
text: Given A SUPERVISOR is signed in and provider 1003000111 has status A (ACTIVE) in provider-service When POST /api/v1/sanctions is called with npi 1003000111, action T, reason 'SYNTHETIC TEST REASON' and effectiveDate 2026-03-31 Then 201 with a Sanction that has a sanctionId, npi 1003000111, action T, resultingStatus T, effectiveDate 2026-03-31, the reason, recordedAt, and recordedBy set to the supervisor; the status was changed only through provider-service's POST /api/v1/providers/1003000111/status-changes with action TERMINATE, effectiveDate 2026-03-31 and the same sanctionId, so GET /api/v1/providers/1003000111 now shows status T (TERMINATED); exactly one SanctionApplied event is published with subject 1003000111, action T, effectiveDate 2026-03-31 and the same sanctionId
title: A termination sets the provider to TERMINATED

text: Given A SUPERVISOR is signed in and provider 1003000333 has status A (ACTIVE) When POST /api/v1/sanctions is called with npi 1003000333, action S, a reason and effectiveDate 2026-03-31 Then 201 with resultingStatus S; provider-service received a status change with action SUSPEND; GET /api/v1/providers/1003000333 shows status S (SUSPENDED) and not D (DENIED); exactly one SanctionApplied event with action S is published
title: A suspension sets the provider to SUSPENDED, not DENIED

text: Given A SUPERVISOR is signed in and provider 1003000333 has status S (suspended in AC-2) When POST /api/v1/sanctions is called with npi 1003000333, action R, a reason and effectiveDate 2026-04-30 Then 201 with resultingStatus A; provider-service received a status change with action REINSTATE; GET /api/v1/providers/1003000333 shows status A (ACTIVE); exactly one SanctionApplied event with action R is published
title: A reinstatement sets the provider to ACTIVE

text: Given A SUPERVISOR is signed in; provider 1003000444 has status D (DENIED), provider 1003000555 has status P (PENDING) and provider 1003000666 has status D (DENIED) When R is recorded for 1003000444 and for 1003000555, and T is recorded for 1003000666 Then Each call returns 201 with no refusal based on the current status: 1003000444 and 1003000555 become A (ACTIVE) and 1003000666 becomes T (TERMINATED); one SanctionApplied event is published per call
title: A sanction is applied whatever the current status

text: Given A SUPERVISOR is signed in and provider 1003000111 is ACTIVE When POST /api/v1/sanctions is called for npi 1003000111 with action X, and again with an empty action Then Each call returns 422 problem+json whose detail names the field action and the allowed values T, S and R, with no legacy code (none of E101-E205 applies); no sanction is stored (GET /api/v1/sanctions?npi=1003000111 is unchanged); provider-service receives no status change and the provider's status is unchanged; no SanctionApplied event is published, so no notice is triggered
title: An unknown action code is rejected

basis: R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00003, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00021, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00022, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00023, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00024, D-013
text: Given A SUPERVISOR is signed in and no provider has NPI 1003000999 (provider-service answers 404) When POST /api/v1/sanctions is called with npi 1003000999, action T and effectiveDate 2026-03-31 Then 404 problem+json whose detail names NPI 1003000999; no sanction is stored for it and no SanctionApplied event is published
title: A sanction for an unknown provider is not found

text: Given A SUPERVISOR is signed in and provider-service is unreachable, or answers with a server error, for NPI 1003000111 (fault injected) When POST /api/v1/sanctions is called with action T and effectiveDate 2026-03-31 for 1003000111 Then 503 problem+json whose detail names NPI 1003000111 (not 404 and not 201); no sanction is recorded as applied (GET /api/v1/sanctions?npi=1003000111 has no new row) and no SanctionApplied event is published
title: A failure to apply is never reported as not found or as applied

basis: R-PRVSAN01-ADD-03, D-018, D-023, ADR-007, modern/docs/architecture/nfr.md, modern/docs/ux/journeys.md#J5, modern/contracts/openapi/sanctions-service.yaml#listSanctions
text: Given Sanctions T and then R were recorded for NPI 1003000111, and tokens for every role When GET /api/v1/sanctions?npi=1003000111 and POST /api/v1/sanctions are called Then ANALYST, SUPERVISOR and ADMIN get 200 with items for both rows, each with action, reason, effectiveDate, recordedBy, recordedAt and resultingStatus (T and A), plus page, size and total (defaults page 0, size 20); PROVIDER and SYSTEM get 403 on the GET and a call without a token gets 401; POST is allowed only for SUPERVISOR (ANALYST, ADMIN, SYSTEM and PROVIDER get 403, no token gets 401)
title: The sanction history is readable, and roles are enforced

text: Given a file in EBCDIC code page 037 or 1047 When tools/data/ebcdic_to_ascii.py is run with the input path, the output path and the code page as a parameter Then the output file has the same number of bytes as the input, one ASCII byte per EBCDIC byte, with no line terminators added
title: A command-line tool converts a file

text: Given a run with no code page, or with an unsupported one When the tool is started Then it exits with a non-zero code and a message that lists the supported code pages 037 and 1047, and writes no output file
title: The code page is required and checked

text: Given a fixture holding letters, digits, space and the punctuation that the legacy layouts use, encoded in 037 and in 1047 When each is converted with its own code page Then both give the same expected ASCII text recorded in the test, and converting a 037 file with 1047 gives a different result for the bytes where the two pages differ
title: Known text converts as expected under both code pages

text: Given an ASCII fixed-width fixture When it is encoded with a code page in the test and converted back with the same page Then the result equals the original bytes
title: Round trip

text: Given a file whose size is not a multiple of the record length given with --lrecl, or a byte that converts to a character outside printable ASCII When the tool runs Then it exits non-zero with a message naming the file size and record length, or the byte offset and value of the offending byte, and never writes a replacement character
title: Record length is verified and non-text bytes are reported

text: Given an input path and an output path that is the same file When the tool runs Then it refuses with a message, and in every run the input file's sha256 is unchanged
title: The original is never touched

text: Given Two PROVIDER users: user A has submitted an application for NPI 1003000111 (VALIDATED) and user B one for NPI 1003000222 (VALIDATED) When User A calls GET /api/v1/applications, and then GET /api/v1/applications?npi=1003000222 Then The first call returns 200 with items containing only the application for 1003000111 and total 1; the second returns 200 with no items and total 0; the application for 1003000222 is never shown to user A
title: A provider lists only their own applications

text: Given User B's application id, and user A signed in as a PROVIDER When User A calls GET /api/v1/applications/{applicationId} with B's id Then 403 problem+json, and none of B's data is in the response
title: A provider cannot open someone else's application

text: Given User A's application for NPI 1003000111 was accepted (journey J1) When User A calls GET /api/v1/applications/{applicationId} Then 200 with status VALIDATED, no errors, source PORTAL, npi 1003000111, medicaidId M00000111, providerType IN, taxonomy 207Q00000X, the individual details and submittedAt
title: A validated application shows its status

basis: modern/docs/ux/journeys.md#J2, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00003, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00004, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00005, D-001, D-016
text: Given User A's application was rejected for an empty taxonomy (journey J2), and a second one was rejected for providerType XX with an empty taxonomy When User A calls GET /api/v1/applications/{applicationId} for each Then The first has status REJECTED and exactly one error with code E104, field taxonomy and a message; the second has status REJECTED and exactly two errors, E102 on providerType and E104 on taxonomy, each listed once
title: A rejected application shows exactly one error per failed check

text: Given Applications of several providers with statuses VALIDATED and REJECTED, some loaded from a legacy file and some submitted in the portal When An ANALYST, and then a SUPERVISOR, calls GET /api/v1/applications?status=REJECTED and GET /api/v1/applications?npi=1003000111 Then The first returns every REJECTED application of every provider (source PORTAL and LEGACY_FILE); the second returns only the applications for NPI 1003000111; each response has items, page, size and total, defaulting to page 0 and size 20
title: An analyst sees every application and can filter

text: Given An ANALYST is signed in When GET /api/v1/applications is called with size=201, with status=FOO, and with npi=123 Then Each call returns 400 problem+json; a call with size=200 returns 200
title: Paging and filter values are checked

text: Given No application has the id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 When An ANALYST calls GET /api/v1/applications/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 Then 404 problem+json
title: An unknown application id is not found

text: Given Tokens for PROVIDER, ANALYST, SUPERVISOR, ADMIN and SYSTEM, and a request without a token When GET /api/v1/applications and GET /api/v1/applications/{applicationId} are called Then PROVIDER (own applications only), ANALYST and SUPERVISOR get 200; ADMIN and SYSTEM get 403 problem+json; a call without a token gets 401
title: Only PROVIDER, ANALYST and SUPERVISOR may read applications

text: Given An ADMIN token and a SANCIN file of 80-byte records When POST /api/v1/batch/sanction-intake-runs is called with the file and businessDate 2026-03-31 Then 202 with a BatchRun that has a runId, a job, businessDate 2026-03-31 and status RUNNING or COMPLETED; GET /api/v1/batch/sanction-intake-runs/{runId} returns the same businessDate; a call without businessDate or without the file returns 400 problem+json and creates no run
title: A sanction intake run starts with an explicit business date

basis: R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00001, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00011, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00012, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00013, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00056, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00057, D-004, modern/docs/analysis/data-layouts.md (PRVSAN01:SANCTION-IN-RECORD)
text: Given A SANCIN file whose records hold the NPI in bytes 1-10, the action in byte 11, the reason in bytes 12-51, the effective date as CCYYMMDD in bytes 52-59 and filler in bytes 60-80, for example NPI 1003000111, action T, reason 'SYNTHETIC TEST REASON', date 20260331 When The run completes Then Every record is read in file order through the last one and counts.read equals the number of records; GET /api/v1/sanctions?npi=1003000111 shows effectiveDate 2026-03-31 (the 4-digit-year date stored as an ISO date) and reason 'SYNTHETIC TEST REASON' (bytes 12-51 without trailing spaces)
title: Each 80-byte record is read from its fixed positions until end of file

basis: R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00017, D-013, D-018, D-006, D-027, modern/docs/analysis/programs/PRVSAN01.md (DD SANCIN)
text: Given ACTIVE provider 1003000111, ACTIVE provider 1003000333 and suspended provider 1003000222, and a file with T for 1003000111, S for 1003000333 and R for 1003000222 When The run completes Then The providers show status T, S and A respectively, set only through provider-service's POST /api/v1/providers/{npi}/status-changes; GET /api/v1/sanctions shows one history row per record with sourceFeed SANCIN and recordedBy the account that started the run; one SanctionApplied event is published per record
title: Each record is applied through provider-service and kept in the history

basis: R-PRVSAN01-ADD-06, R-PRVSAN01-ADD-02, R-PRVSAN01-ADD-01, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00003, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00012, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00021, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00023, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00024, D-024, D-026, Q-B12
text: Given A file of five records: a valid T for 1003000111, a T for NPI 1003000999 that no provider has, action X for 1003000333, a valid action for 1003000333 with effective date 20261331 (not a valid date), and a valid T for 1003000222 When The run ends Then GET /api/v1/batch/sanction-intake-runs/{runId} shows status COMPLETED, endedAt set, error null and counts read 5, applied 2, notFound 1, rejected 2; history rows and SanctionApplied events exist only for the two applied records (1003000111 and 1003000222); provider 1003000333 is unchanged; the service's JSON log contains the line 'PRVSAN01: NPI NOT FOUND 1003000999'; the records after each skipped one are still processed
title: Records that cannot be applied are counted, the run goes on and completes

basis: R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00027, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00054, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00055, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00010, R-PRVSAN01-cbl-00058, Q-B8
text: Given All providers exist, and a file with T for 1003000111, S for 1003000333, R for 1003000222 and T for 1003000555 When The run completes Then counts.applied is 4 and counts.terminated is 2 (S and R do not count); the service's JSON log contains the line 'PRVSAN01: PROVIDERS TERMINATED=00002' (the legacy 5-digit counter)
title: Only terminations are counted as terminated

text: Given A file of three valid records whose second record is only 60 bytes long, and in another run a file of three valid records where provider-service answers with a server error for the NPI of record 2 (fault injected) When Each run is started Then Each run does not stay RUNNING: status FAILED, endedAt set and an error text naming record 2 (and its NPI in the second case); record 1 of each run keeps its result (history row and event) and counts.applied is 1; record 3 is not processed; the failing sanction is not recorded as applied and has no SanctionApplied event
title: An unreadable record or a failure to apply ends the run with a stated failure

basis: modern/docs/architecture/nfr.md (Availability: batch jobs can be re-run for a business date and are idempotent), ADR-004, D-024, D-018, Q-B11
text: Given A run for business date 2026-03-31 of a file with T for 1003000111 and S for 1003000333 completed, and the same file is loaded again for business date 2026-03-31 When The second run completes Then Status COMPLETED with counts read 2, applied 0, skipped 2; no new history row and no SanctionApplied event is created, so no second notice is triggered; the providers keep status T and S
title: Re-running a business date applies nothing twice

text: Given Tokens for ADMIN, SYSTEM, ANALYST, SUPERVISOR and PROVIDER, and a request without a token When POST /api/v1/batch/sanction-intake-runs and GET /api/v1/batch/sanction-intake-runs/{runId} are called, and GET with the unknown runId 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 Then POST returns 202 for ADMIN and SYSTEM, 403 problem+json for the others, 401 without a token; GET returns 200 for ADMIN, 403 for every other role and 401 without a token; the unknown runId returns 404 problem+json
title: Only ADMIN and SYSTEM may start a run and only ADMIN may read its result

basis: R-PRVENR01-cbl-00001, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00010, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00015, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00017, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00018, D-017, D-020, Q-B8, modern/contracts/openapi/enrollment-service.yaml#startIntakeRun
text: Given An ADMIN token and an APPINPUT file of three valid 200-byte records When POST /api/v1/batch/intake-runs is called with the file, businessDate 2026-03-31 and batchId B0331001 Then 202 with a BatchRun that has a runId, a job, businessDate 2026-03-31 and status RUNNING or COMPLETED; GET /api/v1/batch/intake-runs/{runId} returns the same businessDate; the service's JSON log contains the line 'PRVENR01: STARTING ENROLLMENT LOAD - BATCH B0331001'
title: An intake run starts with an explicit business date and batch id

text: Given An ADMIN token and the same APPINPUT file When POST /api/v1/batch/intake-runs is called with businessDate 2026-03-31 and no batchId (or a batchId of blanks) Then 202, and the service's JSON log contains the line 'PRVENR01: STARTING ENROLLMENT LOAD - BATCH DEFBATCH'
title: A missing batch id defaults to DEFBATCH

basis: R-PRVENR01-ADD-01, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00012, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00019, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00007, D-025, D-007, Q-009, modern/docs/analysis/data-layouts.md (PRVRECRD)
text: Given An APPINPUT file with two 200-byte records. Record 1: NPI 1003000111 (bytes 1-10), Medicaid ID M00000111 (11-19), type IN (20-21), taxonomy 207Q00000X (22-31), risk tier H, status A, screen flag P and two dates in bytes 32-50, last name RIVERA (51-80), first name MARIA (81-100), licence number MD12345 (101-115), licence state TX (116-117) and non-blank text in bytes 131-200. Record 2: NPI 1003000444, type GR, taxonomy 207Q00000X, legal name EXCLUDED CLINIC LLC (51-90), DBA name blank (91-120) and owner NPI 1990000111 (121-130) When The run is started and completes Then GET /api/v1/applications?npi=1003000111 as ANALYST shows one VALIDATED application with source LEGACY_FILE and exactly those individual values; the application for 1003000444 shows legalName EXCLUDED CLINIC LLC and ownerNpi 1990000111 (so bytes 121-130 are read); neither the applications nor their ApplicationValidated events carry the text of bytes 131-200 or the risk tier, status, screen flag or dates of bytes 32-50
title: Each record is read as the 130-byte PRVRECRD in bytes 1-130

basis: R-PRVENR01-cbl-00002, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00022, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00003, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00004, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00005, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00024, D-016, D-001, Q-B6
text: Given A file of four records, each otherwise valid: record 1 is a valid application for NPI 1003000111, record 2 has a blank NPI, record 3 is for NPI 1003000222 with type XX, record 4 is for NPI 1003000333 with an empty taxonomy When The run completes Then GET /api/v1/applications as ANALYST shows record 1 VALIDATED with one ApplicationValidated event, and records 2, 3 and 4 REJECTED with source LEGACY_FILE and exactly one error each (E101 on npi, E102 on providerType, E104 on taxonomy); ApplicationRejected events are published for 1003000222 and 1003000333 only (record 2 has no NPI to use as the event subject)
title: Each record gets the same validation as an online application

text: Given A file of three records: a valid application for NPI 1003000111, an application for 1003000222 with an empty taxonomy, and a valid application for 1003000333 When The run completes Then All three records are processed in file order: 1003000111 and 1003000333 are VALIDATED, 1003000222 is REJECTED with one error E104, and the run's counts.read is 3; the rejected application produces no ApplicationValidated event
title: One rejected application does not stop the load

basis: R-PRVENR01-cbl-00006, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00014, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00027, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00033, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00037, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00043, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00044, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00045, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00046, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00047, R-PRVENR01-ADD-06, D-001, D-016, Q-B4, ADR-005
text: Given A file with a valid record and three rejected ones: a blank NPI with type IN, NPI 1003000222 with type XX and an empty taxonomy (two failed checks), and NPI 1003000333 with type IN and an empty taxonomy When The run completes and an ADMIN calls GET /api/v1/batch/intake-runs/{runId}/error-file Then 200 with exactly three rows, in input order, one per rejected application and none for the valid one; each row is 250 characters: bytes 1-10 the NPI as read (blanks for a blank NPI), bytes 11-16 ' TYPE:', bytes 17-18 the type code as read, bytes 19-40 ' ERR:VALIDATION-FAILED' and bytes 41-250 spaces (for example the second row starts '1003000222 TYPE:XX ERR:VALIDATION-FAILED'); for a run with no rejected application the call returns 200 with an empty file
title: The APPERROR file has exactly one row per rejected application

text: Given Tokens for ADMIN, SYSTEM, PROVIDER, ANALYST and SUPERVISOR, a request without a token, and the runId 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 that no run has When POST /api/v1/batch/intake-runs is called with a file and businessDate, and GET /api/v1/batch/intake-runs/{runId}/error-file is called Then POST returns 202 for ADMIN and SYSTEM, 403 problem+json for the others and 401 without a token; the error file returns 200 for ADMIN, 403 for every other role and 401 without a token, and 404 problem+json for the unknown runId; a POST without businessDate or without a file returns 400 problem+json and no run is created
title: Only ADMIN and SYSTEM may start a run, only ADMIN may download the error file, and the run parameters are required

basis: R-PRVENR01-cbl-00009, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00011, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00021, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00057, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00061, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00062, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00067, D-024, modern/contracts/openapi/enrollment-service.yaml#getIntakeRun
text: Given A first run for business date 2026-03-31 of a file with three valid applications (NPIs 1003000111, 1003000222, 1003000333), followed by a run for business date 2026-04-01 of a file with one valid application for NPI 1003000777 When Both runs complete and an ADMIN calls GET /api/v1/batch/intake-runs/{runId} for each Then The first shows status COMPLETED, endedAt set, error null and counts read 3, written 3, errored 0, skipped 0; the second shows read 1, written 1, errored 0, skipped 0, so nothing is carried over from the first run
title: A clean run reports its counts, and each run starts from zero

basis: R-PRVENR01-cbl-00026, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00031, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00036, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00060, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00063, R-PRVENR01-ADD-08, D-024, D-001
text: Given A file of four records: valid applications for NPIs 1003000111 and 1003000777, one with a blank NPI, and one for NPI 1003000222 with type XX and an empty taxonomy (two failed checks) When The run completes and an ADMIN reads the run and downloads its error file Then counts are read 4, written 2, errored 2, skipped 0, so that read equals written plus errored plus skipped; the record with two failed checks is counted once, not twice; the downloaded error file is complete and holds exactly 2 rows
title: Every record is counted exactly once

basis: R-PRVENR01-ADD-04, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00008, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00013, R-PRVENR01-cbl-00064, D-016, Q-B3
text: Given A file holding NPI 1003000111 (no earlier application), the same NPI 1003000111 again, and NPI 1003000222 When The run completes Then The first 1003000111 record and 1003000222 are VALIDATED; the second 1003000111 record is REJECTED with exactly one error E103 and has one APPERROR row; counts are read 3, written 2, errored 0, skipped 1; the first application is unchanged and exactly one ApplicationValidated event exists for 1003000111
title: A duplicate NPI is counted as skipped

text: Given A file with two valid applications and one rejected application When The run completes Then GET /api/v1/batch/intake-runs/{runId} shows status COMPLETED (not FAILED), error null and counts.errored 1, the modern form of the legacy return code 4 'completed with warnings'; the two valid applications keep their VALIDATED status
